method: Inclusive horizontal centre-range geometry, one-unit midpoint bins, current gun/Arc ranges48/72 and silo ranges72/96/120. Range96 gun is inactive. No LOS/pitch/flight/guaranteed-damage claim; complete routes are measured independently, including the common tail.

options.rationale: A western entry passes below the cypress rise and returns through the garden, then follows the limestone approach to a quiet one-cell stream bridge. A separate eastern-bank loop supplies later repeated contact and a northeastern exit, keeping the lower orchard and southern ruin as scenery.

A western approach returns through the cypress-side garden while a northeastern approach bends across a quieter bank and short stream bridge. They meet on dry ground before a shared southern meadow and limestone-side exit. Branch-specific early choices trade against a common later court without forcing the stream or raised knolls to change.
